title: Nice idea, awful UX
body: The app usually fails to recognizing walking trains with watch ultra. The app randomly pauses workouts, even when the work out is in progress. It is impossible to start a workout with one tap on Apple Watch – first you need to open workouts then you need to select specific workout then you need to slide left screen and press start again so it takes three active taps to start. Managing active training from iPhone is really hard because UI works weird.

title: Разачарована
body:
I think writing reviews here is a thankless task. Developers, do you even read user reviews of your product? Judging by the reaction, or rather the complete lack thereof, you don’t care what people think about your product. And as before, discrimination has not gone away; the application for Georgia is still in a truncated form. Every time you make mistakes, I will give you one star. It's no use writing.
